data.one_liner: A comprehensive Flutter package for rating and review stars with animations and layouts.
data.what_it_does: Provides customizable rating and review widgets including star ratings, displays, emojis, sliders, review summaries, badges, and bottom sheets with animations and multiple layout arrangements.
use_when: You need interactive or read-only star or emoji ratings in your app.
You want custom layouts like grids, arcs, waves, or spirals for rating stars.
You need a complete review submission bottom sheet or rating breakdown summary.
avoid_when: You require complex custom graphics engines outside of standard Flutter shapes and custom icons.
strengths: Rich set of customization options including shapes, gradients, animations, and arrangements.
Includes helper widgets like rating badges, review summary breakdowns, and review bottom sheets.
Supports programmatic control via EasyStarsController, haptic feedback, and accessibility.
weaknesses: Focused entirely on ratings and reviews, which may be too specific for generic UI icon tasks.
